thesis: Qualitative replication must specify opportunities, trace generation, recording and coding; preserve partial predictive identification when absolute probabilities and observation processes cannot be anchored.
replication_target: Joint vector of prespecified retrieval and coding outcomes at fixed historical observation opportunities, optionally a directly modeled substantive summary.
novelty_candidate: Protocol-aware predictive checking for BPT with explicit nonidentification, robust observational sensitivity and an auditable holdout design; not discovery of scenario averaging or binary causal simulation.

claims.claim: Likelihood ratios and posterior hypothesis probabilities do not uniquely determine absolute predictive probabilities.
Without false positives, observation probability q=a*rho does not identify occurrence and detection separately.
Observationally equivalent mechanisms cannot be localized by any check using the same targets.
claims.proof_status: equality-of-distributions argument supplied; independent verification pending

claims.claim: Choose reserved opportunities using separation of rival joint predictions robust to admissible observation parameters.
claims.proof_status: criterion proposed, no optimization or simulation executed

absolute_probability_routes: partial predictive envelopes when point anchoring is unavailable
holdout_requirements: freeze model and search protocol before retrieval
exclude all known McCoy/ILD/Lavin examples from fresh validation
reserve a second batch for revised models
do not use LLM convergence as independence evidence

empirical_design.Chile: pilot of documentary observation with public legislative corpus; private mechanisms require genuinely additional records
empirical_design.Oil: main company-episode-time application with separate original-period records and temporal transition validation
empirical_design.selection: metadata-based frame and retrieval log; condition claims on accessible selected archive when needed
empirical_design.dependence: shared event/source genealogy with joint replication
empirical_design.drift: separate date of action from date of disclosure and model later transitions explicitly
